title: Regions
description: The regions of the world in order (D-076, CONTENT §1): each names a region folder next to this file. The first region is the home region; the passages between regions are off-map legs with a fixed time.

id.description: Region ID: the folder content/<id> and the id in its region.json.

prefix.description: Island ID prefix of the region's generated archipelago (<prefix>-NN).

home.description: The home region (exactly one, the first): every world starts there.

gate.description: The building ID that opens the region (D-076 §2), null for the home region.

minutes.description: Passage time in minutes at scale 1, both ways.
